title: Costal Fracture Assessment for Relief and Enhancement of Quality of Life
official: Costal Fracture Assessment for Relief and Enhancement of Quality of Life - CARE Study
summary: This study explores the impact of rib fractures on patient well-being and quality of life, aiming to identify effective interventions for pain relief and functional improvement. It investigates the long-term outcomes of conservative treatment for rib fractures, analyzing factors such as analgesic therapy, hospitalization duration, and respiratory infection rates. Anticipated results include a comprehensive assessment of patient quality of life and the potential translational implications for healthcare practice. Furthermore, the study aims to inform healthcare resource optimization, potentially guiding treatment decisions and improving patient outcomes within the National Health Service.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients with rib fractures

Exclusion Criteria:

* cognitive impairment
* chronic pain due to pathologic fractures
* active cancer
